rationale: Every diff-scoped security check passed (no secrets, no PII in logs, collector token handling clean, sentry config clean, no new allowlist, no advisory on the two new devDependencies). The verdict is FAIL only because gate 'pnpm audit --prod --audit-level=high' exits 1 on 8 pre-existing advisories (4 critical, 2 high) in apps/web and apps/project-tracker dependency paths that this branch does not touch. Per STOA policy any non-zero gate exit is FAIL; there is no WARN. Resolution belongs to a separate dependency bump (next>=16.4.1, @sentry/nextjs>=10.75.2, dompurify>=3.4.17, hono>=4.13.11) or an ADR-accepted risk, not to the IFC-074 code.

checks.name: Collector token handling
checks.evidence: Read grafana-provisioning.mjs + collect-observability-evidence.mjs. Token appears only in the Authorization header (createReadOnlyClient); never in URL, query string or output. Client takes no method parameter and hard-codes method GET. Errors are 'HTTP <status> <name>' or 'invalid JSON from <name>'; run() also scrubs the token from any logged message (scrub()). Missing-env message prints no values. Output is allowlist-validated (check()/assertSafeKeys rejects key names matching key|token|auth|secret|api and host-shaped strings).

findings.summary: pnpm audit --prod --audit-level=high exits 1: next<=16.4.0 (apps/project-tracker), @sentry/nextjs<10.75.2 and dompurify<=3.4.16 (apps/web) carry critical/high advisories; hono<4.13.11 moderate via @prisma/dev. Needs a dependency-bump PR or an ADR-accepted risk.

pino '*.x' redact paths cover one nesting level only; a field nested two or more levels deep (a.b.email) would not be redacted. Not exploitable today because apiLog records are flat and built from allowlisted fields, but a future caller passing nested objects would bypass it. Accept via ADR or add deeper paths.

createReadOnlyClient does not require GRAFANA_URL to be https; the bearer token goes to whatever URL the operator supplies in the environment. Operator-controlled, no attacker input path. Consider rejecting non-https URLs.

apps/api/src/tracing/logger.ts reportFailureOnce writes error.message to stderr when the logger cannot be built (e.g. pino rejecting LOG_LEVEL). The message is pino config text, not request data; no PII path.
